fact: Car 55 driving unnecessarily slowly during Sprint Qualifying
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Competition Notes (item 1, document 5).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz), team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. Car 55 had to let Car 16 by before Turn 13, this impacting his lap time delta. After that, the driver accelerated to make up time before coming into the pits, but still reached Safety Car Line 1 being approx. 5 seconds above the required maximum time. The driver explained that he could not accelerate the car in the way he wanted due to the fact that the battery of the car was empty, but also admitted that he could have done more to make up time before entering the pit lane. The Stewards acknowledge the difficulties arising from energy management, but also agree with the driver that he could have done more to manage his delta time and therefore determine that a Warning to the driver is appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 55 Driving Unnecessarily Slowly During Sprint Qualifying
